nom: PÜR Minerals Joystick Exfoliating Deep Pore Clay Cleansing Stick

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it works well as an exfoliator and one recommends it specifically for oily skin, though one combination/oily reviewer felt it made little difference.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it relieved flakiness and dryness and left skin soft, though one notes the product is not ideal for dry skin types and can feel harsh.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report smoother, softer skin and pore-clearing benefits, though one saw little change in breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report gentle, non-irritating results with softness and no breakouts, but one reviewer with fragrance sensitivity had a severe reaction with burning and blistering.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s report smooth, youthful-looking, soft skin and consider the product suited to mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s describe smoother, softer, more youthful-looking skin and credit the product with facial-like results.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers with dry or flaky skin report the product relieved dryness and flakiness and left skin soft and smooth, though one reviewer says it is not ideal for dry skin and can feel rough.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports skin appeared less red after use; no other redness-specific reports are given.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports stinging and a burning sensation with resulting flaking, while several other sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation at all.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced blackheads, smaller-looking pores, and cleared congestion spots, with one hoping it will fade brown spots but unconfirmed.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and resolved congestion or blackheads; a few report new breakouts, a cystic-like severe reaction, or no improvement at all.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports it targeted oiliness alongside breakouts with good results, and another oily-skin reviewer confirms reduced oil and pore appearance.

aspects.libelle: Product runs out very quickly for price
Difficult to twist up or dispense

extraits.titre: BEWARE, IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE SKIN STAY AWAY
extraits.texte: My skin is not acne prone I'm just sensitive to many face products with fragrance one of the girls at the PUR counter in Ulta recommended this product due to my allergies, I used it ONE time and I woke up the next morning with a burning face and A TERRIBLE breakout. Have NEVER had such a bad reaction to a product it even caused small fluid filled blisters under my nose. Will have to call the allergist tomorrow, to fix what this product has caused. The photos below (Both are WO/ ANY make-up) show the day before I used this product and the day after I used this product and you can be the judge on this product.

This product is very convenient and totally mess-free. I have oily, sensitive, and acne prone skin and this product makes my face feel super smooth and gives it a nice glow. I like to use this 2x a week, before face serums and creams. I am happy that this product is a part of my nighttime skin care routine. I hope you enjoy it as much as I do! :)

extraits.titre: Good product but not enough of it
extraits.texte: I really love this and the way it made my face feel like it had new skin on it every time I used it but the amount of product you get is not enough for the price you pay which is why I'm torn on whether I'll repurchase. I was actually shocked when I reached the bottom of the stick because it was gone so fast. If I repurchase I'll use it more sparingly and less often but it really is an awesome exfoliator that has been great for my dry acne-prone skin and I highly recommend it if it's in your budget.

I LOVE this exfoliator. It doesnt bave much of a fragrance but the texture feels like ground almonds. Always leaves my face looking nice without making it look or feel like its been scrubbed raw. I have sensitive skin and now this joystick goes everywhere with me.

been using this 2-3 times a week to help keep my skin soft & it has been great. I tend to have very acne prone skin but this has not irritated my skin at all. My skin is so soft after use & feels good for several days afterwards

I have very dry skin during the winter months, this was the first product that helped me to get rid of the flaky skin on my face! I use this 3 times a week, wet my face, swirl on the scrub stick, and massage gently in a circular motion, then leave it on for 3 minutes as a mask. VIOLA! Smooth skin! Then I moisturize :) Good stuff! REMEMBER scrubs are not for people with sensitive skin! And even if you have 'normal' skin you should still be gentle when using a scrub. Not sure what happened with the other reviewer that 'scrubbed' her face off but...yowch! Go easy gurl!

I have tried multiple exfoliating products, this by far is the best. I have always had somewhat dry skin and college has sent my acne and oil into full swing. Nothing was working for me until I found this product, I wish I had tried it first! After just one use my skin was smoother, my complexion was more even, less red, not dry or oily and my pores were almost invisible. I bought this item after reading reviews and I will buying this every time I run out. If I could rate higher than 5 stars I would!!
